literal: Like metal rubbed by a file, will wear away, strength being worn down, the family that has suffered internal enmity.
translation: Like metal filed away by a rasp, a family that harbors internal enmity will gradually wear away, losing all its strength.
modern: அரத்தினால் தேய்க்கப்பட்ட இரும்பு தேய்ந்து போவது போல, உட்பகையைக் கொண்ட குடும்பமானது தன் வலிமை அழிந்து மெல்ல மெல்லத் தேய்ந்து போகும்.
explanation: This couplet uses a vivid physical analogy to describe the destructive nature of internal hatred. The word 'அரம்' refers to a file or rasp, and 'பொன்' here denotes metal, which is normally hard and durable. Just as a file slowly but surely grinds down even the strongest metal, internal enmity ('உட்பகை') silently eats away at the core strength ('உரம்') of a family or clan ('குடி'). The destruction is not sudden or loud, but a gradual, inevitable wearing away until nothing remains.
